description: DualQuaternion (product, normalize, try_inverse, lerp) and UnitDualQuaternion (from_parts, translation, products, inverse, divisions, point transforms, to_homogeneous, nlerp, sclerp, the products with unit quaternions, translations and isometries)

format.tolerance_unit: raw units (1 ulp = 2^-32), applies to every output scalar

ops.name: dual_quaternion_mul
ops.doc: a * b = (a.real * b.real, a.real * b.dual + a.dual * b.real)
ops.tolerance: expected = floor(exact result), computed on i128 raws; 0: one rescale per output scalar reproduces it bit for bit

inputs.name: a
inputs.layout: (real (w, i, j, k), dual (w, i, j, k))

inputs.name: b
inputs.layout: (real (w, i, j, k), dual (w, i, j, k))

outputs.name: product
outputs.layout: (real (w, i, j, k), dual (w, i, j, k))

ops.name: dual_quaternion_normalize
ops.tolerance: ceil(4 + 3 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)
